desk-look uses much less CPU in long, busy sessions: the transcript no longer rereads the whole conversation on every message and every spinner tick.

- The folded tool-call lines now keep one small value per call instead of one value for the whole conversation, and only the line whose group changed is drawn again. Before, every visible tool line and the diff pane reread every call's input and output (about 0.8 MB in a 330-call session) each time a call started or finished
- During a turn the folded lines, the progress band's step and the task list are updated from the message just added and the tool's result, and checked against the full conversation once when the turn ends (and after a compaction), instead of reading the whole conversation again after every message
- The spinner's "run in background" hint looks only at the calls running now
- Measured on a 330-call session with a turn of five short commands: desk-look's own work fell by about three quarters, and Claude Code's main thread by about a third
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.81.3 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
